latest_vintage_history_gaps.aap_us_annual: Exact latest 2026-vintage 2022 and 2023 estimates are not in the accessed public release. Full paid reports were not accessed.
latest_vintage_history_gaps.uk_pa_industry: No matched latest-vintage 2022–2024 history was extracted. 2024 original audio £268M cannot be combined with 2025 £255M to infer a decline.

explicit_revision_evidence.interpretation: Different release vintages. Cannot infer 2024 revised revenue by reversing a rounded growth rate.

display_guidance: Use separate plots/facets by series and currency. AAP and UK public amounts should be dated point estimates; continuous trend lines, CAGR, ranking markets and APA/AAP shares would imply comparability not supported here. Rounded publisher-reported growth may be quoted with its release but should not be recomputed from rounded different-vintage levels. Retain table downloads with source URLs and publication dates.
visual_validation: UK 2025 one-page PDF Consumer panel: audio books £255 million, print £2.1 billion, total consumer £2.6 billion. The £254 million figure belongs to academic print journals.
